name: Moon Mountain District Sonoma County

known.via: English Wikipedia "Moon Mountain District Sonoma County AVA" (redirects to "Moon Mountain District Sonoma County")

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A mountainous Sonoma Valley AVA on the western slopes of the Mayacamas Mountains, where thin, well-drained soils come mostly from volcanic rock.
